items.title: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: ZetaChain's migration to Solana could enhance liquidity and user engagement, positioning SOL as a more attractive platform for decentralized applications.

items.title: Why Solana’s new 250ms speed boost could actually trigger network instability
items.whyYouShouldCare: The new speed boost may improve transaction efficiency, but potential instability could deter developers and users, impacting overall network reliability.

items.title: Solana’s October setup: Record activity, ETF inflows, and a brewing breakout
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increased activity and ETF inflows suggest growing interest in Solana, which could lead to a significant price movement and strengthen its market position.
